derivation: Each fix PR changed whole test files and validated those whole files: tessera#642 changed three MoE files, tessera#643 changed two dense files. The roster is every node that pytest collects from those five files at the candidate commit. Fields id, suite, file, function, params come from the collected node ids. Fields line, cuda_gated and purpose come from an AST parse of the candidate test files. Tier 'correction' marks a node that carries an element of a correction (see corrections.json). Tier 'regression' marks every other node of the same files.

owner_roster.note: Neither tessera#610, tessera#611, tessera#642 nor tessera#643 names a node list for the candidate. The issue bodies name 4 and 39 failing nodes at master f587d5b62. The roster extends those to the five whole files at the candidate. A Tessera owner can supersede it; the harness refuses any run whose collected nodes differ from it.
